title: Scratches easily and retains food debris
text: Scratches easily and retains food debris. Bought this and the 20 ounce bowls. Big problem is that they scratch very easily after routine use and food debris accumulates on the scratched surface after washing in a dish washer. Very frustrating....

product_metadata.title: CaliBowl Non-Spill 28-Ounce Low Profile Bowl with Non-Slip Base, Set of 4, Red
features: Set of 4 non-spill, non-slip low profile Calibowls, 28-ounce
Patent pending non-spill smart lip technology, with a silicone non-slip base
Made in usa; bpa-free, non-toxic, environmentally sustainable product
100-Percent recyclable packaging, made of partially recycled material
description: These amazing CaliBowls are the perfect non-spill, non-slip bowls for enjoying salads, pastas, soups and stews. The patent pending design on the CaliBowl features an innovative curved inner-lip that guides food back into the bowls and onto your utensil, eliminating over-the-edge spills and creating effortless food control. The low-profile design is built on a wide, non-slip stable base with a shallow depth for plate-like usage. This 28 ounce size is great for a variety of jobs; comes packed in a set of 4. Dishwasher safe and proudly made in USA.
